arabic text: BAAZAAR YAAD AYA AUR WOH BARASTE PATHAR
english translation text: Upon hearing Abid's name, the prison returned to memory; the marketplace returned, and the raining stones.

arabic text: CHALEES SAAL TAK JO ROYA HAI KHOO'N KE AANSU\nMAAO'N KE SAR KHULE THE, USKE BANDHE THE BAZOO\nWOH KIS QADAR THA HAAYE LAACHAAR AUR LAGHAR
english translation text: For forty years he wept tears of blood.\nThe mothers' heads were uncovered, while his arms were bound.\nAlas, how helpless, frail and weakened he was.

arabic text: MAQTAL MEI'N JIS NE KUNBA PAAMAAL HOTE DEKHA\nAANKHON KE SAAMNE HI KHAYMO'N KO JALTE DEKHA\nBEEMAR O NAATAWAA'N KE CHALTE THE DIL PE KHANJAR
english translation text: In the battlefield he watched his entire family trampled;\nbefore his own eyes he saw the tents burning.\nDaggers moved across the heart of the sick and powerless one.

arabic text: KAANTO'N PE PAA BAREHNA USKO GUZAARTE THE\nJAB THAK KE BAITH TA THA DURRO'N SE MAARTE THE\nROTA THA MERA MOLA HANSTE RAHE SITAMGAR
english translation text: They made him walk barefoot across thorns.\nWhenever he sat from exhaustion, they struck him with whips.\nMy Maula wept, while the oppressors continued to laugh.

arabic text: WO CHAAR SAALA BACHI SAJJAD KI DULHARI\nZINDAA'N MEIN ZULM SEH KAR JAB WHO JAHAA'N SE GUZRI\nGHASH KHA KE GIR GAYA WOH NANHI LAHAD BANA KAR
english translation text: That four-year-old child, Sajjad's beloved,\nafter enduring oppression in prison, departed this world.\nAfter making her tiny grave, he fainted and fell.

arabic text: JAB JAB SE SOCHTA HO'N DIL KAANPTA HAI MERA\nKUL KAAINAAT MEI'N BHI SAABIR NAHI HAI AISA\nPYAARO'N KE SAR KO DEKHA JIS NE SINAA' KE UPAR
english translation text: Whenever I think of it, my heart trembles.\nIn all creation there is no patient one like him,\nwho saw the heads of his loved ones upon spears.

arabic text:
HAATHO'N ME HATHKARI BHI PAYRO'N ME BERIYAN BHI
AANKHO'N SE KHOO'N RAWAA'N THA GARDAN MEIN RASIYAA'N
THI
WHO CHAL RAHA THA PHIR BHI DEE'N KA ALAM UTHAKAR
english translation text:
Handcuffs upon his hands, shackles upon his
feet, blood flowing from his eyes and
ropes around his neck— yet still he walked
while carrying the standard of the faith.

arabic text: AZLAAN AAZMI WHO MERA KARIM MOLA\nBHAI KE QAATILO'N KO JIS RAKHA NA PYAASA\nPAAINI PILA KE BOLA HAYE MERA BARADAR
english translation text: O Azlaan Azmi, my generous Maula\nwas the one who did not leave his brother's killers thirsty.\nAfter giving them water, he cried: alas, my brother.
